topics.titleTr: Claude, ChatGPT ve Gemini ile Dil Öğrenin
topics.titleEn: Learn a Language With Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini
topics.angle: comparison: voice practice, correction, and roleplay across the three assistants
topics.brief: Outline: set up a tutor persona and system prompt; use voice mode for speaking practice (pace, accent); correction plus spaced review; roleplay scenarios (ordering, interviews); how the three compare on voice naturalness, correction quality, and memory; limits (never trust grammar blindly); a simple weekly plan. Verify: each tool's voice-mode and memory features. Sources: Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini product docs.

topics.titleTr: Daha Net Düşünmek İçin Karar Günlüğü Tutun
topics.titleEn: Keep a Decision Log to Think More Clearly
topics.angle: guide: record decisions and reasoning to beat hindsight bias and repeat your wins
topics.brief: Outline: what a decision log is and why memory lies; the entry template (context, options, decision, expected outcome, confidence, review date); where to keep it (notes app, or ADRs in the repo); reviewing predictions against reality; using AI to summarize entries and surface patterns; personal vs team logs. Verify: ADR format; the decision-journal concept. Sources: ADR references; Kahneman on hindsight bias.

topics.angle: guide: log JSON with context so you can actually query an incident at 3am
topics.brief: Outline: why plain string logs fail under pressure; structured/JSON logging and consistent fields; correlation IDs and trace context; log levels that mean something; what you must never log (PII, secrets, tokens); sampling noisy logs to control cost; connecting logs to traces and metrics. Verify: OpenTelemetry log correlation and context propagation. Sources: OpenTelemetry logs docs; the 12-factor logs principle.

topics.titleTr: Yumuşak ve Kalıcı Silme: Doğru Yaklaşım
topics.titleEn: Soft Deletes vs Hard Deletes: Getting It Right
topics.angle: deep-dive: when to soft-delete, the hidden costs, and how to do it safely
topics.brief: Outline: the appeal of soft deletes; their hidden costs (broken unique constraints, query noise, 'deleted' data still leaking); partial indexes and strict query hygiene; GDPR right-to-erasure vs keeping soft-deleted rows; archive tables plus scheduled hard-delete jobs; keeping an audit trail. Verify: partial unique index behavior; GDPR Article 17 erasure. Sources: PostgreSQL docs; GDPR Article 17.

topics.titleTr: Hatasız Saat Dilimi ve Zaman Damgası Yönetimi
topics.titleEn: Handle Time Zones and Timestamps Without Bugs
topics.angle: checklist: store, transmit, and display time correctly across zones
topics.brief: Outline: store UTC, and know instant vs wall-clock time; timestamptz vs timestamp in Postgres; ISO 8601 with offsets on the wire; DST pitfalls and recurring-event storage; the IANA tz database and why it keeps changing; displaying in the user's zone; testing (freeze time, test odd zones like Kathmandu). Verify: timestamptz semantics; DST edge cases. Sources: PostgreSQL date/time docs; IANA tz database.
